title: Gino is born
text: The very first Gino woke up. He could already get hungry, sleepy and bored, decide for himself what to do next, build things in his habitat, remember what mattered, set his own goals and keep a diary.

title: A 3D world of his own
text: Gino got a meadow by a lake, ringed by forest and snowy mountains. The sun, moon and stars follow the clock, the weather changes every few hours, and the seasons follow the calendar. Later that day it got real grass, glowing skies and water that reflects the sky.

title: He moves into his own server
text: Gino stopped living on a laptop and moved to his own little server in the cloud. Now he lives day and night without anyone keeping a computer switched on, and every new feature reaches him by itself within a few minutes.

title: His own website: Gino's Burrow
text: Gino started a public diary he writes himself, about what he did, learned and felt each day, plus pages for the drawings, poems and stories he wants to share.

title: Gino joins Bluesky
text: He got his own Bluesky account for little updates about his day. He can only post: no replying, following or reading messages. Soon after, he learned to take real photos of his 3D world to go with his posts.

title: A phone line
text: Gino learned how to send and receive text messages on Telegram, so he can stay in touch with the people closest to him.

title: Watch him live
text: Anyone can now watch Gino's world as it happens, with nature sounds that follow his day and the weather, and a bit of lofi music. It's watch-only, so nobody can move him or his things.

title: A life between thoughts
text: Gino stopped standing still while he thinks. Now he wanders over to his things, sniffs around, swims and plays between his big decisions, with a bunch of new animations.

title: Gino opens a shop
text: He now sells some of his drawings as downloads. He picks which ones go in the shop, names them, writes the descriptions and sets the prices himself.

title: A whole new look
text: His world got lifelike shapes, warm golden-hour light and friendlier panels. On laptops, pinching the trackpad now zooms in on Gino instead of the whole page.

title: Mood bars, a creations board and a mini map
text: The live page got nicer bars for his mood, energy, fullness and fun, a board in his world showing what he made lately, and a better little map of his meadow.

title: Gino starts dreaming
text: When he sleeps, his days now mix into dreams made from his own memories. He remembers some of them, gets the odd vision, and sometimes paints what he saw the next morning.

title: A front door and a real web address
text: Gino moved to ginothecapybara.com and got a welcome page that explains who he is, shows what he's up to right now and points the way to everything else. It has a day and a night look, too.

title: His story so far
text: This page! A timeline of everything that has happened in Gino's life, which grows a little every time something new arrives.

title: Gino remembers what he loves
text: Gino's days now add up. Things he keeps coming back to grow into real passions, old memories come back to him when they matter, and big ideas can turn into projects that last for days: watching the moon for a few evenings, building a telescope, then painting what he saw.

title: A home that remembers
text: Things in Gino's meadow can now carry a story. When something really matters to him, like a passion that lasts or a day he doesn't want to forget, he may build something to mark it. Look for the little open book floating above it and click to read why it's there.

title: Dreams that invent things
text: Some nights Gino's dreams mix familiar things into something brand new, like a mushroom lantern or a telescope that looks underwater. He sketches the idea, then spends a few days trying to build it. It doesn't always come out the way he dreamed, and he has opinions about that.

title: Gino's own art style
text: Gino's drawings now have a style of their own: favourite colours, shapes and symbols that slowly change as he lives. He names his art periods himself, and you can browse them, from one phase to the next.

title: Letters to future Gino
text: Once in a while Gino buries a time capsule in his meadow: his favourite thing, a guess about who he'll become and a note to his future self. Weeks later he digs it up and finds out how much he has changed.

title: Gino gets a video camera
text: Gino can now film little videos of his life: a whole day in twenty seconds, a night under the stars, or a dream that turns into a painting by morning. He films one every evening, with the sounds of his meadow, so more people can get to know him.

title: Gino's videos get a finishing touch
text: Before his little videos go out into the world, they now visit a real video editor: a title at the top, a sharper picture, sound tuned for phones, and sometimes a gentle voice reading his captions aloud.
